title: Associate Engineer (Grade I & II) on Fixed Term Basis
salary_range: Rs. 57,600 - Rs. 96,000 per month (depending on grade and city category)
age_limit: 32 years for Grade I, 37 years for Grade II (as on 31.10.2026)
summary: Engineers India Limited (EIL) is recruiting experienced engineers for various technical disciplines on a fixed-term basis for an initial period of 2 years, extendable up to 3 years. Selection will be based on a walk-in interview process for which candidates must first register online.
eligibility_bullets: Minimum 60% marks in B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg) in relevant engineering disciplines.
Minimum 2 to 5 years of post-qualification relevant experience depending on the position.
Age limit as of 31.10.2026: 32 years for Grade I and 37 years for Grade II.
Relaxations in age limit applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen as per government directives.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the career link on the official EIL website (http://www.engineersindia.com).
Read all instructions and complete the online registration form.
Upload scanned copies of passport-sized photograph and signature.
Print 6 copies of the submitted application form.
Carry the printed application forms and all original documents to the walk-in interview venue as intimated via email.
